title: What does a planner do in a world-model stack?
summary: It chooses actions or trajectories based on state, goals and expected effects.
body: A planner determines which action, trajectory, policy or intervention should be chosen for a given state or goal. It bridges world understanding and world intervention by evaluating what to do and what an action is expected to cause.
